items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I have a kid right now who’s been around me ever since he was about six years old. His name is Nicholas Payton, you know of him?

ctx.x: So the music and the marketing are two completely different camps.

They’re just two different things. And like I say, a lot of people will argue with me, but a lot of the students that I teach, like I said earlier, their main goal is to be famous. Well man, “I’m trying to get this contract.” What are you going to do when you get the contract, son, you know? I’m sitting right here in the classroom with you and you know, when it comes to, you know, just some modal type of thing where they can do all kinds of jazzy, funny stuff on the instrument, they do quite well. But when it…
